### Lumen Global Illumination

#### Ray Lighting Mode { #unreal-postprocess-lumenraylightingmode }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd>Project Default</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:postProcess:LumenRayLightingMode</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealpostProcessLumenRayLightingMode_c1bl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span></dl>

Controls how Lumen rays are lit when Lumen is using Hardware Ray Tracing. By default, Lumen uses the Surface Cache for best performance, but can be set to 'Hit Lighting' for higher quality.

<div class="hdue-figure" data-figure="tut-lumen-pt-reflections"></div>

| Value | Label |
|---|---|
| `ELumenRayLightingModeOverride::Default` | Project Default |
| `ELumenRayLightingModeOverride::SurfaceCache` | Surface Cache |
| `ELumenRayLightingModeOverride::HitLightingForReflections` | Hit Lighting for Reflections |
| `ELumenRayLightingModeOverride::HitLighting` | Hit Lighting |

#### Lumen Scene Lighting Quality { #unreal-postprocess-lumenscenelightingquality }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd><code>1</code></dd></div><div><dt>Range</dt><dd>0.25 to 2</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:postProcess:LumenSceneLightingQuality</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealpostProcessLumenSceneLightingQuality_h9bl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span></dl>

Scales Lumen Scene's quality. Larger scales cause Lumen Scene to be calculated with a higher fidelity, which can be visible in reflections, but increase GPU cost.

#### Lumen Scene Detail { #unreal-postprocess-lumenscenedetail }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd><code>1</code></dd></div><div><dt>Range</dt><dd>0.25 to 4</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:postProcess:LumenSceneDetail</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealpostProcessLumenSceneDetail_tubl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span></dl>

Controls the size of instances that can be represented in Lumen Scene. Larger values will ensure small objects are represented, but increase GPU cost.

<div class="hdue-figure" data-figure="ref-lumen-scene-detail"></div>

#### Lumen Scene View Distance { #unreal-postprocess-lumensceneviewdistance }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd><code>20000</code></dd></div><div><dt>Range</dt><dd>1 to 2097152</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:postProcess:LumenSceneViewDistance</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealpostProcessLumenSceneViewDistance_l4bl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span></dl>

Sets the maximum view distance of the scene that Lumen maintains for ray tracing against. Larger values will increase the effective range of sky shadowing and Global Illumination, but increase GPU cost.

#### Final Gather Quality { #unreal-postprocess-lumenfinalgatherquality }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd><code>1</code></dd></div><div><dt>Range</dt><dd>0.25 to 2</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:postProcess:LumenFinalGatherQuality</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealpostProcessLumenFinalGatherQuality_75bl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span></dl>

<div class="hdue-figure" data-figure="tut-noise-lumen-quality"></div>

#### Screen Traces { #unreal-postprocess-lumenfinalgatherscreentraces }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd>On</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:postProcess:LumenFinalGatherScreenTraces</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealpostProcessLumenFinalGatherScreenTraces_dfcl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span></dl>

Whether to use screen space traces for Lumen Global Illumination. Screen space traces bypass Lumen Scene and instead sample Scene Depth and Scene Color. This improves quality, as it bypasses Lumen Scene, but causes view dependent lighting.

<div class="hdue-figure" data-figure="ref-lumen-screen-traces"></div>

#### Max Trace Distance { #unreal-postprocess-lumenmaxtracedistance }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd><code>20000</code></dd></div><div><dt>Range</dt><dd>1 to 2097152</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:postProcess:LumenMaxTraceDistance</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealpostProcessLumenMaxTraceDistance_y2bl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span></dl>

Controls the maximum distance that Lumen should trace while solving lighting. Values that are too small will cause lighting to leak into large caves, while values that are large will increase GPU cost.

<div class="hdue-figure" data-figure="ref-lumen-max-trace-distance"></div>

#### Lumen Surface Cache Resolution { #unreal-postprocess-lumensurfacecacheresolution }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd><code>1</code></dd></div><div><dt>Range</dt><dd>0.5 to 1</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:postProcess:LumenSurfaceCacheResolution</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealpostProcessLumenSurfaceCacheResolution_qdcl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span></dl>

Scale factor for Lumen Surface Cache resolution. Smaller values save GPU memory, at a cost in quality. Defaults to 0.5 for Scene Captures if not overridden.

#### Hardware Ray Tracing { #unreal-cvar-r-lumen-hardwareraytracing }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd>On</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:cvar:r:Lumen:HardwareRayTracing</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealcvarrLumenHardwareRayTracing_gwbebf</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span></dl>

Uses Hardware Ray Tracing for Lumen features, when available. Lumen will fall back to Software Ray Tracing otherwise. Note: Hardware ray tracing has significant scene update costs for scenes with more than 100k instances. Console variable r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing (process-wide).

<div class="hdue-figure" data-figure="ref-lumen-hardware-ray-tracing"></div>

#### Lumen Scene Lighting Update Speed { #unreal-postprocess-lumenscenelightingupdatespeed }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd><code>1</code></dd></div><div><dt>Range</dt><dd>0.5 to 4</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:postProcess:LumenSceneLightingUpdateSpeed</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealpostProcessLumenSceneLightingUpdateSpeed_zgcl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span><span class="hdue-badge">Advanced</span></dl>

#### Final Gather Lighting Update Speed { #unreal-postprocess-lumenfinalgatherlightingupdatespeed }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd><code>1</code></dd></div><div><dt>Range</dt><dd>0.5 to 4</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:postProcess:LumenFinalGatherLightingUpdateSpeed</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealpostProcessLumenFinalGatherLightingUpdateSpeed_rqcl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span><span class="hdue-badge">Advanced</span></dl>

Controls how much Lumen Final Gather is allowed to cache lighting results to improve performance. Larger scales cause lighting changes to propagate faster, but increase GPU cost and noise.

#### Diffuse Color Boost { #unreal-postprocess-lumendiffusecolorboost }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd><code>1</code></dd></div><div><dt>Range</dt><dd>1 to 4</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:postProcess:LumenDiffuseColorBoost</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealpostProcessLumenDiffuseColorBoost_l4bl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span><span class="hdue-badge">Advanced</span></dl>

Allows brightening indirect lighting by calculating material diffuse color for indirect lighting. Values above 1 (original diffuse color) aren't physically correct, but they can be useful as an art direction knob to increase the amount of bounced light in the scene. Best to keep below 2 as it also causes reflections to be brighter than the scene.

<div class="hdue-figure" data-figure="ref-lumen-diffuse-color-boost"></div>

#### High Quality Translucency Reflections { #unreal-postprocess-lumenfrontlayertranslucencyreflections }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd>Off</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:postProcess:LumenFrontLayerTranslucencyReflections</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealpostProcessLumenFrontLayerTranslucencyReflections_nvcl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span></dl>

Whether to use high quality mirror reflections on the front layer of translucent surfaces. Other layers will use the lower quality Radiance Cache method that can only produce glossy reflections. Increases GPU cost when enabled.

#### Max Roughness To Trace { #unreal-postprocess-lumenmaxroughnesstotracereflections }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd><code>0.4</code></dd></div><div><dt>Range</dt><dd>0 to 1</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:postProcess:LumenMaxRoughnessToTraceReflections</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealpostProcessLumenMaxRoughnessToTraceReflections_rqcl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span></dl>

Sets the maximum roughness value for which Lumen still traces dedicated reflection rays. Higher values improve reflection quality, but greatly increase GPU cost.

<div class="hdue-figure" data-figure="tut-lumen-pt-roughness"></div>

#### Max Reflection Bounces { #unreal-postprocess-lumenmaxreflectionbounces }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd><code>1</code></dd></div><div><dt>Range</dt><dd>1 to 8</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:postProcess:LumenMaxReflectionBounces</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealpostProcessLumenMaxReflectionBounces_h9bl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span></dl>

Sets the maximum number of recursive reflection bounces. 1 means a single reflection ray (no secondary reflections in mirrors). Currently only supported by Hardware Ray Tracing with Hit Lighting.

#### Max Refraction Bounces { #unreal-postprocess-lumenmaxrefractionbounces }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd><code>0</code></dd></div><div><dt>Range</dt><dd>0 to 64</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:postProcess:LumenMaxRefractionBounces</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealpostProcessLumenMaxRefractionBounces_h9bl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span></dl>

The maximum count of refraction event to trace. When hit lighting is used, Translucent meshes will be traced when LumenMaxRefractionBounces \> 0, making the reflection tracing more expenssive.

#### Hardware Ray Traced Reflections { #unreal-cvar-r-lumen-reflections-hardwareraytracing }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd>On</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:cvar:r:Lumen:Reflections:HardwareRayTracing</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealcvarrLumenReflectionsHardwareRayTracing_dfcebfl</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span><span class="hdue-badge">Advanced</span></dl>

## Shadows

#### Virtual Shadow Maps { #unreal-cvar-r-shadow-virtual-enable }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd>On</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:cvar:r:Shadow:Virtual:Enable</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealcvarrShadowVirtualEnable_xpbebgh</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span></dl>

#### Shadow Map Filter { #unreal-cvar-r-shadow-filtermethod }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd>PCF</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:cvar:r:Shadow:FilterMethod</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealcvarrShadowFilterMethod_bobebg</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Realtime only</span><span class="hdue-badge">Advanced</span></dl>

Chooses the shadow filtering method. 0: Uniform PCF (default) 1: PCSS (experimental) Console variable r.Shadow.FilterMethod (process-wide).

| Value | Label |
|---|---|

| `1` | PCSS |

## Dome and Viewer Lights

#### Environment Cube Resolution { #unreal-domeresolution }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd>128</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:domeResolution</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealdomeResolution_n8a</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Advanced</span></dl>

Face size of the cubemap dome lights are baked into, for lighting, reflections and the background.

| Value | Label |
|---|---|
| `32` | 32 |
| `64` | 64 |
| `128` | 128 |
| `256` | 256 |
| `512` | 512 |
| `1024` | 1024 |
| `2048` | 2048 |

#### Light Unlit Scenes { #unreal-autoviewerlight }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd>On</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:autoViewerLight</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealautoViewerLight_99a</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Advanced</span></dl>

Add a camera-relative key and fill light when the scene has no lights, so unlit scenes are reviewable.

#### Viewer Light Intensity { #unreal-viewerlightintensity }

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Default</dt><dd><code>4</code></dd></div><div><dt>Range</dt><dd>0 to 100</dd></div><div><dt>USD attribute</dt><dd><code>unreal:viewerLightIntensity</code></dd></div><div><dt>Houdini parameter</dt><dd><code>xn__unrealviewerLightIntensity_fjb</code></dd></div><span class="hdue-badge">Advanced</span></dl>
